compatibility: Support the target project's declared PHP runtime, including legacy runtimes when detected.
Do not introduce syntax or standard-library assumptions newer than the project's supported PHP version.
rules: Read composer constraints and platform settings before changing language-level syntax.
Treat PHP version as a project fact, never as a bootstrap-wide assumption.
Preserve existing autoloading and extension requirements unless the active change explicitly migrates them.
verification: Syntax-check changed PHP files with a compatible PHP runtime when available.
Run project-native tests or smoke checks rather than assuming PHPUnit exists.
